senses.example: My mind, calmer and stronger now than last night, made for itself some imperious rules, prohibiting under deadly penalties all weak retrospect of happiness past; commanding a patient journeying through the wilderness of the present...

senses.definition: To look or refer back to; to reflect on.
senses.example: To give a correct idea of the circumstances which have gradually produced this conviction, it may be useful to retrospect to an early period.
